(4) blocked-user-visible-on-boards deviation to record'). Blocking someone hides them from chat (`chat_messages` SELECT policy's `NOT private.is_blocked(auth.uid(), chat_messages.author_id)`, `20260722000001_is_blocked_private_schema.sql:104`) and friend-request surfaces (`friendships` SELECT policy's two-directional `NOT private.is_blocked(...)` checks, same migration:113-114) but NOT from public leaderboards. Verified by reading every RLS policy/query that can surface another user on a board: `workout_attempts`/`leaderboard_entries` SELECT policies (`20260723000001_public_workout_repository.sql:130-143`) — fix wave 1 (Phase O Task 7, 2026-07-19) correction: the following quoted policy text is verbatim for `workout_attempts` only, NOT for `leaderboard_entries` — `workout_attempts`' own policy is exactly `USING (is_opt_in_leaderboard = true OR user_id = auth.uid())` (`:130-132`), while `leaderboard_entries`' policy is a structurally different (merely semantically equivalent) `USING (user_id = auth.uid() OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workout_attempts wa WHERE wa.id = leaderboard_entries.attempt_id AND wa.is_opt_in_leaderboard = true))` (`:134-143`) — no `is_blocked` reference in either policy, and `Profile.topLifters()`'s query (`Models/Profile.swift:132-141`, a plain `profiles` ORDER BY `lifetime_volume_lifted` LIMIT read under `profiles`' own `USING (true)` SELECT RLS). A blocked/blocking pair can still see each other's rows on a routine's leaderboard (e.g. 'The Murph') and the global Top Lifters board. Not a Guideline 1.2/5.1.1 compliance gap (Phase M already closed the direct-contact surfaces block is required to cover: chat, friend requests) — a public leaderboard reads as a non-interactive scoreboard, the same category as a public routine's own author byline (also unfiltered by block state today) rather than a communication channel — but it is a real, user-visible privacy gap worth naming rather than silently leaving undocumented. Candidate fix (deferred, not designed here): extend the `is_blocked`-gated idiom already used for chat/friendships to `leaderboard_entries`/`workout_attempts` RLS and `topLifters()`'s query — real product surface, out of this item's scope to implement.
